title: Podcast Insights
none: No transcript: import text or use cloud transcription
failed: Operation incomplete. Check network, input and library location.
empty: No episodes. Import a podcast link to start.
noHits: No matching text. Try another keyword.
notePrompt: Add a note to the selected quote
confirmDelete: Delete the selected local entries? A backup and legacy source files remain; this does not delete provider data.
deletedBackup: Entries deleted from the current index; backups and legacy files retained.
openTask: Open the new Cindy task to continue; select the matching RSS and confirm cloud fees there.
timeout: Request timed out. Reopen the library and check task status before retrying a write.
fileTooLarge: Transcript file exceeds 5 MB. Split it before importing.
chooseFeed: Select the matching RSS. No candidate is selected automatically.
cloudDisclosure: AssemblyAI receives the audio URL and processing options, not the episode title, existing transcript or saved notes. It fetches the complete audio. This plugin does not request zero retention or a training opt-out; verify your account policies before confirming. Confirm processing rights and charges.
modelDisclosure: Reading and searching return transcript text to Cindy; remote model services may receive it. Library storage does not mean analysis stays on this device.
citeBoundary: Quote matching verifies original wording, not AI interpretation.
keyHint: Optional. Publisher and user transcripts work without a key.
privacy: Cloud transcription sends an audio URL to AssemblyAI for full-audio processing; confirmation and provider charges apply. Stopping tracking does not cancel remote work.

errors.NO_TRANSCRIPT: No transcript. Import text or use cloud transcription.
errors.AAI_KEY_MISSING: Save your AssemblyAI key in plugin settings.
errors.AAI_FETCH_FAILED: AssemblyAI could not process this audio. Import an existing transcript.
errors.NETWORK_FORBIDDEN: Source denied access. Check permissions or provide another public link.
errors.NETWORK_FAILED: Request incomplete. Check connection and provider status.
errors.FEED_TOO_LARGE: RSS exceeds 10 MB. Use another feed or import an episode.
errors.XYZ_PARSE_FAILED: Cannot parse this page. Paste RSS or Apple Podcasts link.
errors.RSS_NOT_FOUND: No RSS found. Provide RSS or an episode audio link.
errors.LIBRARY_UNAVAILABLE: Library unavailable. Restore its location in plugin settings.
errors.USER_CLICK_REQUIRED: Click the confirmation card yourself; the Agent cannot confirm.
errors.SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN: Submission uncertain. Check provider jobs; do not resubmit.
errors.ACTIVE_CLOUD_JOB: Cloud work is pending. Resolve its status before deleting local entries.
errors.AUDIO_TOO_LARGE: Audio exceeds 256 MB or 4 hours; cloud submission is disabled.
errors.TASKS_UNAVAILABLE: Task API unavailable. Import through a Cindy task or update the client.
errors.QUOTE_MISMATCH: Quote differs from original. Select an original passage.
errors.AAI_REJECTED: Provider rejected submission. Check credentials or request parameters.
errors.XML_UNAVAILABLE: XML parser unavailable. Update Cindy or import transcript text.
errors.SOURCE_AUTH_REQUIRED: Source requires authentication. Provide an accessible public RSS or transcript; an AssemblyAI key cannot authorize this source.
errors.SOURCE_PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN: Source URLs cannot access the credentialed transcription API. Provide a public RSS or transcript URL.
errors.EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT: No speech transcript was returned. The cloud task has ended; review provider charges and use another authorized source.
errors.TRANSCRIPT_SEGMENT_LIMIT: Transcript exceeds20000 source segments/cues. Split into smaller imports.

quoteTooLong: Quote exceeds 1200 characters. Select a shorter passage; nothing was saved.
excerptNotice: Excerpt around the matching words; […] marks omitted source text. Open the library for the complete passage.
evidenceInLibrary: The matching passage exceeds the card limit. Open the library to verify the complete source.
searchExcerpt: Shortened search excerpt. Open the library for complete source text.
searchLimited: Search result budget reached. Narrow the query or show/episode filters.
